required_patches.description: Pass the resolved lld path as argv[0] instead of the literal "ld.lld", so MLIR's ROCDL target finds the linker when it is not on PATH under that name.
Support waves_per_eu min,max range attribute for full VGPR utilization.
Support schedule bank and vgpr/agpr/sgpr hint

AMDGPU: carry llvm.amdgcn.sched.{bank,vgpr,sgpr,agpr} allocation hints onto the register the coalescer keeps (SIRegisterInfo::updateRegAllocHint), so a hint on a loop-carried value survives PHI elimination and coalescing; a soft hint never replaces a strict one. Test: llvm/test/CodeGen/AMDGPU/sched-gpr-hint-coalescing.ll.
required_patches.upstream_status: not yet submitted; fix on top of ROCm/FlyDSL#1307's schedule-bank-and-gpr.patch
